suggestions.assertion: Every relationship has a non-empty target_entity
suggestions.reason: Passes by absence of target_entity field in the serialized JSON (jq filter returns 0 vacuously). The in-memory structure DOES carry target_entity (evidenced by correct Mermaid emission), but the JSON serializer drops it. Either serialize target_entity to JSON for asserbility, or change the assertion to verify through Mermaid edges instead.
Stub-before-edge assertion uses byte offsets which are brittle to frontmatter edits. Prefer line-number ordering.

eval_feedback.overall: R2 fix verified — external Role target is emitted as a stub node before the edge; no more dangling references in the Mermaid.
